instruction: Look at the 2023 book reading spreadsheet on your desktop. Find which book was completed in the shortest number of days and write the book's title in the 'book_list_result.docx' document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the book completed in the fewest days. Verified with Python: Books sorted by days are The Shining (6 days), Brave New World (19 days), 2001: A Space Odyssey (23 days), etc. The book read in fewest days is 'The Shining' with 6 days. Evaluator checks if the DOCX contains 'The Shining'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: extracts all text content from DOCX file using python-docx library, handles missing files gracefully
Metric logic is correct: performs case-insensitive substring search for expected text, which is appropriate for this task
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses expected.get('text') which correctly handles the rules dictionary returned by get_rule
Expected value is semantically correct: 'The Shining' is verified as the book completed in shortest time (6 days) according to metadata
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement - that the book title is written to the DOCX file
Postconfig is appropriate: activates Writer window and saves document to ensure file state is persisted before verification
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves file -> getter extracts text -> metric checks for expected text
